problem.text: quantize_exl3 computed proxy_err_2 but returned proxy_err, leaving the return name undefined after quantization and packing.

reasoning.text: The one-line fix assigns the existing normalized error calculation to proxy_err, matching the unchanged return contract without altering the calculation.

impact.text: This removes the return-name failure blocking the inspected direct caller, Linear.convert_exl3, from constructing LinearEXL3 and returning the metric.

source_notes.text: The earlier memory-management entry recorded this undefined-name defect. Inspection of the parent function and task patch shows that this change removes that specific defect.

limitations: No full quantizer, PyTorch or CUDA execution was performed. The scalar check isolates assignment and return behavior, not tensor arithmetic or successful end-to-end conversion.
Caller inspection covers the direct Linear.convert_exl3 call found by literal search, not every broader conversion entry point.

claims.text: After LDLQ, the metric uses transformed-space residual E = weight_r - weight_q and reference W = weight_r. Each scalar einsum sums X[i,k] * H[i,j] * X[j,k]; the residual contraction is divided by the reference contraction. The 1e-8 denominator floor protects against a zero or smaller denominator and is unchanged.

Renaming the assignment preserves sequential contractions, tensor-reference cleanup, optional weight reconstruction and packed-tensor construction. The returned tuple remains weight_q, proxy_err, out_tensors; changing the local assignment is sufficient to reconnect the computed scalar to that interface.
Linear.convert_exl3 unpacks this tuple, constructs LinearEXL3 from the packed tensors while preserving the original bias, and returns either proxy_err alone or proxy_err with weight_q.

An isolated standard-library check using the inspected assignment and return statements raised NameError for the parent spelling. With the patched spelling, numerator 2 and denominator 4 returned metric 0.5; denominator zero returned 200000000.0 through the unchanged floor. This checks scalar binding and division only.

annotation.summary: Fixes the proxy-error variable name so quantize_exl3 returns its computed metric instead of referencing an undefined name.
